purpose: Single user-authorized frugal diagnostic: whether a camera push develops coherent graphic-novel detail from a wide first frame. No automatic retries or variants. Not a song edit or shotlist.
estimateBasis: Previous local Kling 4.0 batch: 340 credits for 34 seconds; not a guaranteed quote.

shots.prompt: One continuous six-second camera dolly-in through this illustrated coastal courtyard, no cuts. Begin at the supplied wide composition with the singing narrator large at left. Camera travels forward and slightly right, passing to the RIGHT of the narrator without intersecting her body; she exits naturally through the left edge by parallax. Move directly toward the elderly seated couple at the small courtyard table, the man in a light cap and brown sweater and the gray-haired woman in a coral jacket. Finish with a close two-shot of their faces and upper bodies across the table, filling most of the frame. They stay seated in their original chairs and positions, quietly conversing with one small hand gesture and a subtle smile. Other residents continue minimal natural movements and do not acknowledge the narrator. Keep camera movement smooth and purposeful, reach the couple by five seconds and settle for the last second. This must be a real spatial camera move with parallax, not simply enlarging the flat starting image. As the couple gets closer, resolve their same faces into finely drawn mature features, expressive eyes, individual hair strands, tactile fabric and nuanced ink crosshatching at the same rendering sophistication as the foreground narrator. Preserve their identity, age, head shape, proportions and clothes throughout: added coherent drawing detail, not changing into new people. Maintain graphic-novel ink-and-painted illustration throughout, never photography, plastic 3D or simplified children's cartoons. Distinct strong tapered silhouette contours and warm dimensional painted shading; distant forms remain simplified, cooler and lower contrast. Keep architecture rigid and stable, people correctly seated and hands anatomically coherent. No new people, no scene transition, no morphing, no sudden face replacement, no text. Do not add music or dialogue audio. The narrator can continue a subtle silent singing gesture as she leaves the frame; lip synchronization is not being tested.
